name: row-menu-wears-the-space-tint
description: the sidebar row menu's .ctxmenu wears .ov-card (sidebar.css), so its color reads the tint C++ pushes into the sidebar document (PushOverlayTheme) rather than a sidebar.css literal. Same open gesture and fixture as a-page-click-closes-the-sidebar-menu.json. two-tabs.spaces.json's startup space carries tint oceanBlue, which rust/atrium-core/src/tint.rs resolves to #0F2B46, so the expected triplet is 15 43 70.
